notes: Original locator describes multiple tests; the specific test extracted is identified in target_description. No metrics converted. Supplied frozen cache is a different thesis (Gino et al. replication) and was not altered or used for statistics. Correct 2021 thesis by Chan On Ying acquired through OSF qswe3/Theses/2021 (HKU)/UG, file Young and Saxe (2011) Replication and Extension.pdf, download URL https://osf.io/download/u59ab/. Supplied https://osf.io/u59ab is a file GUID, not a node (node API returns 404). New cache keyed by corrected file download URL to preserve existing DOI-keyed frozen cache. Replication design combines original experiments into one mixed design and adds failed attempts; statistics retained as printed for the located replication, with design differences disclosed. Main results are pre-exclusion; no post-exclusion n or p substituted. Replication d is explicitly printed in Table 5 and Table 9; p is from the same failed-attempt paired contrast in Table 9.
